title: Bivariate Hardy-Sobolev Inequality and Its Sharp Stability
summary: This paper establishes a bivariate Hardy-Sobolev inequality. Let $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^N$ ($N \geq 3$) be an open domain, $s \in (0,2)$, $α> 1$, $β> 1$ with $α+ β= 2^*(s)$, and $κ\in \mathbb{R}$. For any functions $u, v \in D_0^{1,2}(Ω)$, we prove the inequality: \begin{multline*} \int_Ω |\nabla u|^2 \, \mathrm{d}x + \int_Ω |\nabla v|^2 \, \mathrm{d}x \ge S_{α,β,λ,μ}(Ω) \left( \int_Ω \Big( λ\frac{|u|^{2^*(s)}}{|x|^s} + μ\frac{|v|^{2^*(s)}}{|x|^s} + 2^*(s) κ\frac{|u|^α|v|^β}{|x|^s} \Big)\, \mathrm{d}x \right)^{\frac{2}{2^*(s)}}. \end{multline*} We derive the best constant $S_{α,β,λ,μ}(Ω)$ and…
